name: Moroccan Chicken Skewers
notes: Discovered and rated divine during October Conference 2021 in Channahon. Serve with pilaf and a yummy salad. Drizzle any extra sauce over the pilaf.

items: Grated zest and juice of 1 lemon
2 Tbsp ground cumin or coriander (or mix)
2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thigh, halved lengthwise
Fresh cilantro or mint or flat parsley or mix

steps.title: Mix the marinade
steps.body: In a medium bowl, mix **grated zest and juice of 1 lemon**, **1 Tbsp finely grated fresh ginger**, **¼ cup olive oil**, **2 Tbsp honey**, **2 Tbsp ground cumin or coriander** (or mix), **2 tsp salt** and **1 tsp black pepper**.

steps.title: Reserve some sauce
steps.body: Set aside **2 Tbsp** of the mixture in a separate bowl.

steps.title: Coat the chicken
steps.body: Toss **2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thigh**, halved lengthwise, into the remaining mixture.

steps.title: Skewer and arrange
steps.body: Scrunch the chicken onto skewers and place on a foil lined rimmed baking dish. Add to the baking dish: **4 lemon halves**, cut side up.

steps.title: Broil
steps.body: Broil, 4" from element, for about 12 minutes until charred, turning halfway through.

steps.title: Add the sauce
steps.body: Remove from the oven, and drizzle the reserved sauce over the lemons. Sprinkle over the chicken: fresh cilantro or mint or flat parsley or mix.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve lemons alongside the skewers for squeezing over the chicken.
